Authority boundary . SCI-MAP-v0.2-SHARED-AUTHORITY is the sole normative scientiﬁc source. This
document is its canonical rendered normative scientiﬁc view. It preserves the canonical equations, 52
requirements, 25 predictions, exact state and support semantics, provenance, and conformance routing.
The science-team rationale r0.3 is explanatory and has no independent authority. The Engineering Con-
formance Speciﬁcation supplies prospective evidence, execution, traceability, and verdict procedure with
no independent science; this formal view is not the sole detailed conformance procedure. This document
does not claim implementation conformity, representation ﬁdelity, scientiﬁc validation, observational per-
formance, or production readiness.
Physical model and contract at a glance
MAP consumes the realized MAP-facing output of PTC; it never bypasses PTC to consume CAL output directly.
ALIGN/AST supplies the coordinate facts and MAP supplies the target grid and declared projection. SCI-MAP
applies one ﬁxed, positive-coeﬃcient linear averaging operator to the signal and to every declared linear companion.
A coadd then applies a second positive-coeﬃcient operator to atomically admitted, compatible observation bundles
on the same grid. All scientiﬁc statements are conditional on the complete admitted calibration, alignment, eligibility,
coeﬃcient, response, geometry, and covariance state.
Facet Compact authority
Input Realized SCI-PTC v0.1/r0.5 calibrated- x-derived nonpolarimetric
total-intensity-equivalent product in mJy/beam, with exact originating nominal-beam
identity, occurrence/generation, retention, causes, and response state; exact AST
RTC-grid coordinates for the same stable sample and parent; and an explicitly selected,
completely handed-oﬀ admitted PTC MAP coeﬃcient family.

1 Scientiﬁc boundary and estimand
The ordinary observation map estimates the coeﬃcient-weighted average of the admitted realized PTC sample
quantity in each declared map pixel. Its meaning is inherited through the required CAL-to-PTC route, from
ALIGN/AST’s coordinate relation, and from PTC’s transformed signal, product identity, availability, producer-
local validity, and MAP-facing coeﬃcient. SCI-MAP does not repair or reinterpret those facts. V AL may register
and evaluate a named rule, but it is not the author of producer or MAP policy.
Let i bind observation, detector occurrence and UID, stable RTC output sample n, exact PTC prod-
uct/application generation, segment, and array/network/group; time is an attribute and storage positions
are locators. Here zi = Z PTC
i is the realized PTC transformed signal and γi is its exact PTC-owner-selected
MAP-facing coeﬃcient. The paired x/r symbols remain KID readout coordinates. The eﬀective coeﬃcient
is api = Gpiγi. The admitted SCI-PTC:uniform_constant@draft-0.1 supplies exact dimensionless γi = 1 , but
neither Registry presence nor MAP permission selects or realizes it. Use requires explicit selection, complete
atomic PTC publication, exact target/payload/occurrence association, a requested, applicable, eligible, realized
SCI-PTC:uniform_coefficient_handoff@draft-0.1 decision, independent MAP admission, and MAP ﬁnite-positive
classiﬁcation. An absent selection or incomplete or mismatched handoﬀ makes the aﬀected route unavailable; there
is no unity, alternate-family, loading, sensitivity, scatter, or precision fallback.
The ﬁxed contribution set Cp factors transformed-signal availability, PTC retention, coeﬃcient availability, coef-
ﬁcient/QC, SCI-MAP:map_upstream_admission@2, AST validity, ﬁnite signal, ﬁnite positive coeﬃcient, admitted projec-
tion/boundary, and MAP-local companion gates. Each retained typed state σg is projected to a Boolean membership
predicate bg; T/F/U/C and V AL’s four axes are never conjoined directly. Evaluation follows the structural, safe
numerical-classiﬁcation, coordinate/product, membership, and accumulation stages. Only structurally admitted
payloads are read for MAP classiﬁcation, and all required gates pass before payload arithmetic. Every source state,
immutable reason, cause, provenance, and failure scope is retained. Let Π eﬀ be the recorded eﬀective product
support policy and Sout(Π eﬀ ) the exact set of map rows for which every support predicate that policy designates
applicable passes. This is a row domain, not a numerical mask. The frozen ordinary result is then reused directly:

Boolean zero here means estimator nonmembership only. It is never multiplied into zi, and it never erases the
retained typed record or cause.
The supported division is not a recipe for ﬁlling unsupported pixels. Pre-normalized accumulators and
representation-speciﬁc storage slots may exist outside Sout, but the normalized scientiﬁc vector has no row there.
A dense zero, sentinel, or coincidentally ﬁnite payload is not a semantic substitute and is not measured zero sky.
Likewise, Qp is a normalization fact. Its dimensions or historical name do not make it precision.
The active role is a calibrated- x-derived nonpolarimetric total-intensity-equivalent quantity in mJy/beam. The exact
originating ﬁxed-nominal-beam/template and CAL/PTC lineage are part of the quantity identity. Neither the unit
nor a STOKES token promotes it to Stokes I. V0.2 does not authorize polarimetry, measured-R mapmaking, JINC,
maximum-likelihood mapmaking, mosaicking, or reprojection.

2 Linear operator, response, and absolute mode
For the selected frozen plan Π , transformed-sample input domain IΠ , projection matrix G, diagonal coeﬃcient
matrix Ω , neutral full-grid pixel vector v, exact ﬁxed-state upstream-to-PTC response Hﬁxed, Θ , and output-row
selector Jout, the map operator, ﬁxed-state response, and conditional covariance are:
DQ = diag(GΩ 1), Joutv = (vp)p∈Sout, DQ, out = JoutDQJ T
out, (10)
AMAP, Π ≡ Aout ≡ D− 1
Q, outJoutGΩ , ˆmout = AMAP, Π z, (11)

The identity AMAP, Π ≡ Aout ≡ D− 1

SCI-MAP:one_hot_containing_pixel@1, support policy, target WCS/grid, immutable parents, and lifecycle generation.
The diagonal DQ, out contains only ﬁnite positive normalizations on Sout, so its ordinary inverse is deﬁned. The
matrix has no rows outside that set. Extending it to the full storage grid by writing zeros would be a representation
convenience, not this scientiﬁc operator, response, or covariance.
Every valid MAP product discloses this complete realized AMAP, Π identity as its known MAP-local operator response.
That disclosure is distinct from the upstream-conditioned response below and remains available when the latter is
limited or unavailable.
Here NPTC is a declared covariance of PTC-domain processed-sample error when such information is available, not
the ensemble covariance of sky plus error. The state Θ contains all selected or estimated calibration, alignment,
membership, coeﬃcients, response, geometry, identity, and eﬀective-support facts. Equation ( 12) therefore makes a
conditional perturbation statement on exactly the authorized rows; it makes no unnamed µ0 or residual-bias claim.
If any element of Θ is estimated from the same data, an unconditional claim requires its joint uncertainty and
cross-covariances.
The linear object Hﬁxed, Θ has an exact source domain, PTC-sample codomain, unit transformation, parent, mem-
bership, support, coeﬃcient state, and response basis. It is not a name for a reﬁtted procedure. When available,
Rﬁxed, Θ = AMAP, Π Hﬁxed, Θ describes the response of that exact frozen state on the authorized output domain. A
stored kernel image is the realized response to a named unit-bearing template τ only if its sample-domain parent is
k = Hﬁxed, Θ τ and the stored map is AMAP, Π k = Rﬁxed, Θ τ with the same exact row identity as signal. Without that
identity it is a tracer, not the measured response. If any signal member lacks the required exact parent, response is
limited or unavailable on the unchanged signal membership; no hidden subset, zero, or identity array can stand in
for it. A realized PTC-grid companion begins at MAP and receives AMAP, Π exactly once; it is never passed through
upstream response again.
PTC full-procedure and PTC+MAP re-resolved responses are bounded ﬁnite-diﬀerence families, not one H matrix:

A numerical full-procedure diﬀerence is deﬁned only by the complete immutable SCI-MAP-FULL-PROCEDURE-
COMPARISON-SPACE record. The record binds baseline and perturbed product identities; scientiﬁc quantity and
unit; occurrence or MAP output-row identities; source and target frame/WCS; additive reference, gauge, and null-
space state; baseline and perturbed support; coeﬃcient and response basis; one exact common comparison domain;
an exact map from each result into that domain; explicit treatment of rows present in only one result; perturbation
amplitude, sign, side, location, source state, and normalization; ﬁnite- diﬀerence convention; state-transition
record; and numerical availability with cause. It authorizes no implicit zero ﬁll, union-domain sentinel, support
intersection, coordinate-nearest or same-shape/row-position association, interpolation, reprojection, or gauge

SCI-MAP v0.2 | Formal Scientiﬁc/Engineering Contract Document r0.3
alignment. Without the complete authorized record the numerical diﬀerence is unavailable, or the result is only a
separately typed state transition/discontinuity. ∆ SPTC-FP never establishes subtractability by itself.
Every numerical procedure response shall bind that complete SCI-MAP-FULL-PROCEDURE-COMPARISON-SPACE record deﬁned
in this section.
Here α binds amplitude, sign, perturbation side, source state, location, normalization, domain, and every other
family parameter. ∆ SPTC-FP separately records changed masks, groups, rank, loading subspace, classiﬁcations,
coeﬃcient state, stop cause, support, and other selected state. Equation ( 15) applies only when MAP membership,
coeﬃcient, projection, and support remain ﬁxed. Equation ( 16) instead uses separately resolved Π 0 and Π +, which
may produce diﬀerent membership and output rows; it is the PTC+MAP re-resolved procedure response only after
exact maps into the authorized common comparison domain are bound, not the ﬁxed MAP operator applied to one
matrix. The reserved whole-chain RTC-to-CAL-to-PTC-to-MAP response would rerun RTC, CAL, AST-dependent
selection, PTC, MAP admission, coeﬃcient/support resolution, and MAP from exact immutable parents under
separate authority; it is unavailable unless separately established and is not claimed here. An unavailable upstream-
conditioned response state does not invalidate the numerical map or prohibit later analysis. A later simulated
response or response-corrected map is a new versioned product bound to the original MAP product and processing
identity; it does not rewrite the original product’s claim.
V0.2 ﬁxes the signal-centering operator to L = I. SCI-MAP therefore does not remove a mean or a constant mode
during coaddition. It preserves a constant admitted sample vector on the exact support-authorized output rows
because numerator and denominator use identical coeﬃcients. A stronger constant-sky statement additionally re-
quires the forward operator to map that sky mode to the admitted sample constant. Neither result alone establishes
point-source, integrated-ﬂux, extended-source, edge, or absolute astrometric ﬁdelity. The PTC nonrestored additive
reference λ, ﬁtted correlated removed component ˆUcorr, total removed component Utotal, Θ , removed-subspace iden-
tity, ﬁxed-state null space, full-procedure invariant/unidentiﬁable modes, and any separately authorized residual
conditional bias are distinct facts. Any absolute mode already removed upstream remains absent and must be
carried in response and null-mode provenance.

3 Input classes and falsiﬁable response behavior
The same response equation yields distinct, testable input classes without granting them equal scientiﬁc meaning:
Constant.
Fixed positive coeﬃcients preserve a constant admitted sample vector even when coverage and variance vary.
Delta or basis pixel.
The output is a support-row-restricted column of Rﬁxed, Θ , including beam, projection, preprocessing, and
boundary eﬀects.
Point-source template.
The output is Rﬁxed, Θ τb on exactly the authorized rows. Peak, integrated, and ﬁt amplitudes are diﬀerent
functionals.
Resolved, gradient, and F ourier structure.
The output is Rﬁxed, Θ τ; constant preservation says nothing about these modes.
V ariable coverage.
Fixed-coeﬃcient normalization may preserve a constant while covariance and nonconstant response vary spa-
tially.
Finite boundary .
Truncation can preserve a local constant yet change a compact-source peak or integral. No wrap or clamp is
authorized.
The authorized base family is SCI-MAP:one_hot_containing_pixel@1. It uses half-open pixel cells, assigns unity to the
unique ﬁnite in-grid containing pixel, excludes the outer upper boundary, never wraps or clamps, and has ∑
p Gpi = 1
only on that in-grid domain. Fractional projection remains a future role; no kernel, conservation, boundary-loss,
response, or covariance semantics are inferred for it.
Response ﬁdelity is therefore a validation layer, not a consequence of code executing the algebra. Delta, point-
template, extended, Fourier, variable- coverage, and edge injections are preregistered in Appendix D; they are not
run or claimed here.

4 Conditional uncertainty and statistical labels
For independent selected sample errors with an exact selected coeﬃcient family proven to be true inverse variance,
the general formal relation is:

Equation ( 18) states why normalization is not precision by default. One-hot geometry satisﬁes the projection part
of the equality, but cannot establish that γ is calibrated inverse variance or that sample errors are independent. The
admitted uniform family has exact value one but explicitly supplies no precision or independence meaning.
The following objects must not be conﬂated:
1. Q, an ordinary normalization with its declared gridding unit;
2. ϕ = 1/ [Cm, out]pp, formal conditional marginal precision under its named assumptions;
3. Cm, out or C +
m, out, the full conditional covariance or precision on the identiﬁable stochastic subspace of the exact
authorized row domain; and
4. NOI’s exact conditional_detector_sign_randomization_marginal_second_moment and conditional scale,
with only the claim authorized by that NOI method;
5. NOI standardized signal, whose sole current claim is MAP signal standardized by that conditional second-moment
scale; and
6. any future calibrated-signiﬁcance method, which requires separate exact authority and is unavailable here.
SCI-NOI owns its exact realization-generation, empirical-uncertainty, conditional-scale, and standardization meth-
ods and products. Any physical- noise, total-uncertainty, covariance-completeness, signiﬁcance, probability, false-
rate, completeness, purity, or catalogue interpretation requires a separately approved exact method and remains
unavailable by default. MAP therefore keeps Q normalization, formal conditional precision, complete conditional
covariance, the NOI conditional_detector_sign_randomization_marginal_second_moment, the NOI standard-
ized signal, and any future calibrated-signiﬁcance method as distinct identities and claims.
The bundle reports what uncertainty or covariance information it actually provides, its meaning, domain, assump-
tions, and limitations, and whether fuller information is persisted, lineage-resolvable, summarized, incomplete, or
unavailable. Missing correlations are named, not set to zero. Neither normalization, hits, exposure, nor diagnostic
weight is silently promoted to covariance. Absence of a complete covariance model does not invalidate the map or
prohibit later scientiﬁc analysis. A later covariance estimate is a new versioned product bound to the original map
and processing identity. The base map need not carry a complete covariance matrix or operator; it must disclose
what actually persists and what remains lineage-resolvable or unavailable.

5 Distinct map facts, support, and MAP-local validity
The base/unﬁltered MAP bundle separates facts because they answer diﬀerent questions:
Fact Meaning
AST-geometric incidence Which coordinate-valid occurrences touch the unique containing pixel,
independent of signal availability.
MAP-route-candidate
incidence
Which exact realized PTC occurrences also pass the occurrence-level MAP
upstream-admission proﬁle.
Estimator-admitted
contributions
How many occurrences passed every ordinary coeﬃcient and contribution
predicate.
Admitted observation
count
How many complete observation bundles contribute to a coadd pixel; not
sample hits or attempted observations.
Upstream-eligible
original-footprint exposure
Unique original acquisition footprints ancestral to route candidates, placed
by each original’s own AST ALIGN-grid coordinate in the target WCS; not
complete temporal support.
Retained original-footprint
exposure
The same original-footprint estimand restricted to ancestors of
estimator-admitted membership; not precision or eﬀective integration time.
Normalization support The numerical threshold predicate used to authorize ordinary division.
Science-policy support The separately stricter adopted policy predicate.
MAP-local base-product
validity
MAP’s conjunction of admitted identity, support, ﬁnite signal, and no
MAP-product failure; not downstream eligibility.
No one fact is an alias for another. In particular, exposure is not precision, positive normalization is not ﬁnal
validity, and a ﬁnite payload is not evidence of scientiﬁc availability.
ALIGN owns eacq and valid-original evo, in seconds on stable original occurrences. RTC, CAL, and
PTC preserve those facts, exact lineage, and causes. MAP deduplicates by observation, detector occur-
rence/UID, stable original/native occurrence, stable ALIGN slot, and ALIGN mapping generation. Under
SCI-AST_TO_SCI-MAP_ORIGINAL_FOOTPRINT_COORDINATE v0.1/r0.1 , each positive- evo original is placed exactly once using
its layered AST ALIGN-grid direction/tangent/continuous-pixel parent in the exact target MAP WCS, with
exact geometry/pointing realization, frame, validity, boundary, parent, and version. A descendant RTC-output
coordinate is never substituted:

reconstructible from duration or count. Causal inﬂuence/support is published separately from representative RTC
occurrence and physical original-footprint exposure. Neither exposure plane is complete temporal support, eﬀective
map integration time, precision, or normalized-map inﬂuence.

The dimensionless c = coverage_cut follows the ﬁve-stage MAP lifecycle. Pre-application validation checks its
exact observation-resolved value; application binds that value to one attempt and a later realized product record
exists only when actual immutable scientiﬁc output was produced. It is ﬁnite and nonnegative. Exact zero requests
no relative cut; both thresholds become zero, but the row’s own ﬁnite strictly-positive normalization remains
mandatory. Values 0 < c ≤ 1 are the ordinary recommended range. A value above one requires the independently
authorized, same-value and same-scope Boolean plan fact coverage_cut_above_one_override_requested; the
numerical value does not authorize itself and may honestly leave science support empty. The 2026-09-08 owner
directive selects for this r0.3 candidate the following empty-support disposition; ﬁnal acceptance of these exact r0.3
bytes remains pending. If a valid applied support policy yields Sout = ∅, or a valid applied coadd support policy
yields S c
out = ∅, the application state is applied_no_support_authorized_output_rows, the product and attempt
outcome is not_produced, and the exact cause is no_support_authorized_output_rows. The record retains
request, eﬀective, observation-resolved, and applied stages; exact parent and plan; coeﬃcient, projection, support,
role and proﬁle identities; Q⋆, thresholds and support predicates; proof that the output-row set is empty; attempt
identity, cause, and provenance. It has no realized MAP product or completion marker and publishes no dense zero
map, zero-sky measurement, valid ordinary signal plane, no-row coadd member, or fabricated response/covariance
plane. No immutable empty-row scientiﬁc-bundle alternative is authorized. This is a prospective rule for a future
active route; this candidate asserts no current applied attempt. A negative, non-ﬁnite, missing, or unrepresentable
value fails before support rows are constructed, application begins, or a required product is mutated. Each reached
requested, eﬀective, observation-resolved, applied, and realized state/value is retained; a successful realization has
all ﬁve, while a stop before application, failure, or no-support nonproduction has only its reached preﬁx. The
override record also binds request identity, authorized owner/proﬁle, scope, exact value, cause, and provenance. No
universal numerical default is supplied. Both threshold comparisons are inclusive, and neither support state implies
exposure, precision, signiﬁcance, response, completeness, or physical optimality.

6 Observation coaddition on one common grid
Coaddition consumes immutable complete logical observation bundles, not independent planes. Physical persistence
follows the eﬀective output plan; conforming in-memory and persisted bundles have the same scientiﬁc identity, ad-
mission, and arithmetic. A coadd-only entry may consume persisted conforming bundles without rerunning upstream
processing. Every required publication still completes or fails, and this rule does not waive upstream PTC comple-
tion. The MAP-owned SCI-MAP:observation_coadd_admission@2 is the proposed owner-governed aggregate- proﬁle iden-
tity for this candidate. For the r0.3 generation, the proposed owner-governed MAP proﬁle semantics are candidate;
scientiﬁc-owner approval is pending; canonical Registry registration is pending; source binding is pending; SCI-V AL
activation/evaluability is unavailable; and an object-speciﬁc decision realization is unavailable. In particular,
SCI-MAP:observation_coadd_admission@2 is the proposed owner-governed aggregate-proﬁle identity for this candidate.
After exact owner acceptance, canonical Registry/source binding, and activation, SCI-V AL may evaluate it for a
requested object. The same candidate-generation separation applies to SCI-MAP:map_upstream_admission@2. Earlier
exact proﬁle approvals and evaluations retain their own immutable source generations; this candidate does not
rebind or relabel them. Its future object-decision axes independently record request, applicability, eligibility, and
decision-artifact realization; those axes are distinct from the MAP lifecycle and attempt outcome. The historical
SCI-MAP:observation_coadd_admission@1 record remains immutable and is not an alias for this role-aware successor. It
atomically checks quantity and nominal-beam convention, PTC route/product role, response source/class, com-
plete AST frame/WCS/grid, support policy, coeﬃcient family, covariance disclosure, null/additive-reference state,
required companions, lifecycle, and parentage before any coadd-owned state changes.
The six independently requestable product roles are SCI-MAP:base_observation_map@1, SCI-MAP:response_bearing_

coadd@1, and SCI-MAP:covariance_qualified_coadd@1. Every request has its own immutable identity, parent set, ordered
MAP lifecycle, result, and failure scope. A stronger role is a new product over the exact base parent; it does not
rewrite that parent’s signal membership, response/covariance status, validity, or provenance.

The canonical target grid may be requested and made immutable before observation-map construction. The only
v0.2 placement is exact centered integer embedding on the same grid. Observation and coadd row and column
diﬀerences are nonnegative and even; their half-diﬀerences are the integer oﬀsets, and the shifted reference pixels
identify the same world coordinate. The lossless typed WCS is the authority. A later crop is a newly identiﬁed row-
selected product with an immutable parent and lineage; it cannot relabel that parent as compatible. No fractional
shift, post-hoc pad, interpolation, reprojection, mosaicking, wrapping, or implicit source recentering is allowed.

retains its unique-original own-coordinate placement. A rejected observation changes no coadd state anywhere, even
if a subset of its planes would otherwise appear compatible.

7 Identity, WCS, units, and lifecycle
A map cannot be reconstructed from its collection position. Paired PTC x/r components remain upstream detector
coordinates and are carried only when a MAP-facing fact requires their identity; MAP does not recast r as a response.
The minimum identity includes the nonpolarimetric total-intensity-equivalent product role; external observation or
coadd ID; array/group and occurrence domains; estimator, projection, PTC and coadd coeﬃcient families; MAP-
local operator and upstream-conditioned response/covariance states; signal unit and exact nominal-beam parent;
complete AST frame/WCS; preconstruction target-grid identity where applicable; exposure convention; logical-
bundle and persistence state; MAP proﬁles; exact PTC/AST generations and product identity. A STOKES ﬁeld is
only a locator unless separate quantity authority exists. The policy must be scientiﬁcally identiﬁable, durable, and
comparable, but this contract prescribes no JSON, hash, or sidecar serialization. Array ID, name, index, network,
map group, map index, detector occurrence, and container position remain distinct.
Science maps bind the complete frame identity supplied by SCI-AST:rtc_output_grid_coordinates@1, including the actual
reference system, equinox/epoch, time scale, site/model state, TAN topology, WCS, axis order, signs, handedness,
and degree-valued axes. MAP never equates J2000, FK5, ICRS, apparent, observed, or unrefracted frames by
name/default. Pointing and OOF may reuse the exact ordinary MAP gridding operator when their inputs satisfy
this contract. Their target WCS/frame, source model, ﬁtting, response interpretation, outputs, defaults, proﬁles,
and qualiﬁcation remain mode- owned; no unsupplied mode proﬁle becomes available. FITS/WCS coordinates are
one-based and in-memory row/column indices are zero-based.
Full-precision typed or sidecar WCS is the lossless admission and provenance authority. For an immutable ﬁnite
MAP grid of nx by ny cells, the 0.1-arcsec representation-test population is the ﬁnite union of (a) every scientiﬁcally
addressable integer pixel center (j + 1, k + 1) for 0 ≤ j < n x, 0 ≤ k < n y, and (b) every outer-footprint cell vertex:
(h + 1
2 , 1
2 ), (h + 1
2 , n y + 1
2 ) for 0 ≤ h ≤ nx, together with ( 1
2 , l + 1
2 ) and (nx + 1
2 , l + 1
2 ) for 0 ≤ l ≤ ny. The
second set includes all four outer corners and every required outer-boundary vertex. The complete population is
preregistered from the full-precision typed WCS, grid shape, and row domain before the physical FITS WCS is
generated. Both representations shall bind the same WCS-generation identity, celestial frame, axis order, signs,
handedness, orientation, shape, and centered-integer reference-pixel relation. At every population member, each
WCS is evaluated at the exactly corresponding center (zero-based memory index (j, k ), one-based FITS pixel
(j + 1 , k + 1) ). Separation is the great-circle angle atan2(∥u × v∥, u ·v) between unit direction vectors in that
exact declared frame, evaluated with IEEE-754 binary64 round-to-nearest, ties-to-even operations and reported in
arcseconds. The maximum over the complete ﬁnite population shall be at most 0.1 arcsec. If either WCS yields
an invalid or non-ﬁnite direction at any preregistered member, the representation fails; the point is not dropped.
A center is absent only when its scientiﬁc row was already absent before population generation; every listed outer-
boundary vertex remains required. No smaller sampled subset or continuum/global-sky claim is authorized. This
is a representation tolerance, not authority for a diﬀerent grid.
The exact MAP lifecycle is requested, effective, observation_resolved, applied, realized, in that
order. requested is immutable accepted intent. effective is its supported executable interpretation.
observation_resolved means every observation-speciﬁc parent, coeﬃcient, proﬁle, geometry, mapping, pa-
rameter, support rule, output role, and persistence decision is concrete or typed unavailable. applied binds
the exact resolved operation and parameter state to the invocation or commitment of one execution attempt.
realized exists only when actual immutable accumulators, scientiﬁc output rows, product values, role-qualiﬁed
companion statuses, product identity, and provenance were produced. Attempt outcome is a separate axis with
values succeeded, failed, and not_produced. A stop before application has neither an applied nor a realized
product record. An applied attempt that fails retains its attempt identity and immutable failure-evidence record
but creates no realized MAP product. An applied attempt with no support-authorized output rows has outcome
not_produced, not failure, and likewise creates no realized product.

The MAP plan, coeﬃcient selection/application, projection, support policy, output/coadd plan, response/covariance request,
product role, and coverage_cut use this same ordering. Each parameter stage binds its exact value and provenance; a
completed realization contains all ﬁve stages, while a nonproducing attempt contains only stages actually reached.
The MAP lifecycle does not replace the independently named PTC/V AL handoﬀ axes requested/not_requested,
applicable/inapplicable/applicability_unknown, eligible/ineligible/decision_unavailable, and
realized/incomplete/failed/not_produced. It also does not replace the ECS requirement-result vocabulary or
evidence- artifact realization state. In particular, a MAP parameter’s resolved or applied value may be checked
before application or bound after application; its realized value is never a prerequisite for a pre-application check.
Resolution, application, and realization are distinct. Pre-application validation examines the exact observation_
resolved parameter and proﬁle state. Application binds that resolved state to one attempt. A later realized
product record exists only when actual immutable MAP output was produced; attempt failure evidence does not
realize the product and cannot be used retroactively as the prerequisite that authorized the attempt. MAP product
realization and application-attempt outcome are independent. succeeded means the requested immutable MAP
product was realized. failed means the attempt terminated at an exact failure stage and retains cause, aﬀected
scope, and nonmutation evidence without a realized MAP product or completion marker. not_produced means no
MAP product was realized without asserting producer failure; the authorized empty-support case uses this value.
A response or covariance status of unavailable inside a permitted realized base bundle is a companion-status fact,
not attempt failure. Evidence-artifact realization is another independent axis.
Candidate | no conformity or performance claim Page 16

SCI-MAP v0.2 | Formal Scientiﬁc/Engineering Contract Document r0.3
8 Failure, downstream boundary, and immutable parentage
Failure semantics protect the scientiﬁc bundle from partial truth. An invalid candidate can be excluded at contri-
bution scope; an unsupported pixel is MAP-local invalid; an incompatible observation is rejected atomically only
at the scope of the exact selected role and its required facts; an unrepresentable ﬁnite aggregate, coordinate/index
conversion, missing role-required companion, or failed required publication propagates at its declared product scope
before live state mutation. A pre-application stop has no applied or realized product record; a terminal failure after
application retains the applied attempt and immutable failure evidence without a fabricated realized product. A
valid applied no-support outcome instead retains the exact attempt, proof, and not_produced cause without assert-
ing failure. An unavailable response or covariance inside a permitted realized base bundle is a companion-status
fact, not attempt failure. A completion marker cannot override a missing required output.
No downstream package receives a bare signal plane as a complete map. The boundary includes the estima-
tor and normalization identity; response state; conditional covariance/formal-weight state and assumptions;
distinct map facts; additive-bias and null-mode state; units; WCS; grouping; lifecycle; base/unﬁltered MAP
parentage; dependency versions; and failures. SCI-NOI owns its exact realization-generation, empirical-
uncertainty, conditional-scale, and standardization methods and products. Any physical- noise, total-
uncertainty, covariance-completeness, signiﬁcance, probability, false-rate, completeness, purity, or catalogue
interpretation requires a separately approved exact method and remains unavailable by default. MAP
therefore keeps Q normalization, formal conditional precision, complete conditional covariance, the NOI
conditional_detector_sign_randomization_marginal_second_moment, the NOI standardized signal, and any
future calibrated-signiﬁcance method as distinct identities and claims. NOI may propagate a ﬁxed operator only
under its exact method. FLT owns ﬁltered support, response, covariance, and validity. SRC, MODE, and BEAM
own inference and ﬁt uncertainty. FRUIT owns recurrence and iteration state.
Every later analysis is responsible for deciding which facts its own claim requires. An unavailable response prevents
the original MAP bundle from making an unsupported response-dependent claim, but it does not prohibit analysis
or invalidate other map claims. A signiﬁcance analysis cannot relabel merely formal standardization; an absolute-
level claim cannot ignore an unobservable oﬀset. This contract deﬁnes no closed-world registry of all future uses. A
downstream product may have local validity or eligibility, but it cannot rewrite MAP-local base-product validity or
sever the immutable base/unﬁltered MAP-parent identity.
When an admitted noise realization is described as using the same operator, membership, projection, grouping,
coeﬃcients, normalization, exact support-authorized row selection, boundary, and coadd admission are ﬁxed or
identically prescribed. Recomputing them from randomized data creates a diﬀerent estimator, regardless of matching
array shapes or ﬁlenames.
Candidate | no conformity or performance claim Page 17

SCI-MAP v0.2 | Formal Scientiﬁc/Engineering Contract Document r0.3
9 Uncertainty, validity, validation, and claim layers
The contract deliberately separates four reasoning layers:
1. Uncertainty layer: conditional covariance and response are propagated through the ﬁxed operators; omitted
state uncertainty remains explicit.
2. V alidity layer: contribution eligibility, numerical support, science-policy support, and MAP-local base-product
validity determine the exact rows on which the estimator is scientiﬁcally available; unsupported rows are absent,
not zero-ﬁlled observations.
3. V alidation layer: preregistered analytic ﬁxtures, matrix comparisons, injections, covariance controls, represen-
tation round trips, and observational references test distinct claims.
4. Readiness layer: implementation evidence, operational reliability, data completeness, and release authority
are assessed elsewhere.

no disqualifying gaps.
Floating reductions require a preregistered bound derived from operation count and conditioning. For a sum of n
terms, a reference policy may use γn = nϵ/ (1 − nϵ) and a ﬁxed multiple such as the admitted core’s 8γn

exact. Tolerances are not relaxed after failure.

10 Owner decisions, external hard gates, and route disposition
All nine stable MAP decisions are decided for successor drafting. OD-001–007 and OD-009 use the approved 2026-
08-28 dispositions; OD-008 retains the exact one-hot half-open projection. PTC-OD-010 supplies the versioned
coeﬃcient- Registry architecture, and the owner-approved uniform authority supplies one exact family, handoﬀ

C Canonical requirements
This appendix is rendered directly from the shared canonical LaTeX authority. Requirement identiﬁers are stable
within SCI-MAP v0.2. Editing prose in this document does not silently change them.
SCI-MAP-REQ-001 – V ersioned authority . The scientiﬁc contract version shall be v0.2. The rendered
document revision shall be recorded separately as r0.3; changing layout or exposition alone shall not be represented
as a new scientiﬁc contract version.
SCI-MAP-REQ-002 – Capability and realized PTC input. The ordinary input shall be the realized SCI-PTC
v0.1/r0.5 transformed calibrated- x product zi = Z PTC
i , a nonpolarimetric total-intensity-equivalent detector-time
quantity in the inherited top-of-atmosphere, point-source-equivalent mJy/beam convention with its exact originating
ﬁxed-nominal-beam identity. Neither that unit nor a STOKES token establishes Stokes I. MAP has no CAL-to-
MAP fallback, no inferred no-op PTC product, and no product when the required positive-rank PTC product is
absent or PTC is disabled.
SCI-MAP-REQ-003 – Exact occurrence identity . Every candidate occurrence i shall bind observation, de-
tector occurrence and UID, stable RTC output sample n, exact PTC product/application generation, segment, and
array/network/group as applicable. Sample time is an associated attribute. Input-column, row, and container
positions are locators only and shall not establish identity or equality.
SCI-MAP-REQ-004 – Producer facts and MAP admission. SCI-MAP shall consume PTC-owned
transformed-signal availability, output-retention disposition, coeﬃcient family/value/typed availability, and coeﬃ-
cient/QC proposition without reinterpretation. The PTC coeﬃcient/QC proposition passes only when the coeﬃcient
is requested, applicable, eligible, and realized under the exact PTC-owned coeﬃcient/QC proﬁle for the declared
MAP-facing family. It does not grant MAP use. SCI-MAP shall separately apply SCI-MAP:map_upstream_admission@2
only after its exact owner acceptance, canonical Registry/source binding, and activation. For the r0.3 generation,
the proposed owner-governed MAP proﬁle semantics are candidate; scientiﬁc-owner approval is pending; canoni-
cal Registry registration is pending; source binding is pending; SCI-V AL activation/evaluability is unavailable;
and an object-speciﬁc decision realization is unavailable. In particular, SCI-MAP:observation_coadd_admission@2 is
the proposed owner-governed aggregate-proﬁle identity for this candidate. After exact owner acceptance, canonical
Registry/source binding, and activation, SCI-V AL may evaluate it for a requested object. The same candidate-
generation separation applies to SCI-MAP:map_upstream_admission@2. Earlier exact proﬁle approvals and evaluations
retain their own immutable source generations; this candidate does not rebind or relabel them. V AL Core
may then evaluate that MAP-authored policy for an exact requested object but does not author it. The im-
mutable r0.5 proﬁle SCI-MAP:map_upstream_admission@1 is historical, is not a compatibility alias, and shall not replace
SCI-MAP:map_upstream_admission@2. Every fact, decision, cause, scope, and immutable reason remains separately typed.
SCI-MAP-REQ-005 – Coordinate and projection authority . MAP shall consume
SCI-AST:rtc_output_grid_coordinates@1 for the same stable RTC sample n and complete parent chain as zi; it shall never
join by time, row, cardinality, or coordinate equality. MAP owns Gpi through SCI-MAP:one_hot_containing_pixel@1:
the unique ﬁnite in-grid pixel whose cell contains the coordinate under half-open bounds contributes Gpi = 1, every
other pixel has Gpi = 0 , and an outer-upper-boundary or out-of-grid coordinate contributes nowhere. Fractional
projection is deferred. AST may materialize the relation only when the artifact binds the AST parent and exact
MAP plan.
SCI-MAP-REQ-006 – Ordinary coeﬃcient status. The ordinary route requires one explicitly se-
lected PTC-owned MAP-facing analysis/gridding coeﬃcient family satisfying SCI-PTC-REQ-052–055 and
SCI-PTC_TO_SCI-MAP_BOUNDARY v0.2-draft.1/r0.4 . The historically owner-approved and source-bound Registry
SCI-PTC:analysis_gridding_coefficients@draft-0.1 contains SCI-PTC:uniform_constant@draft-0.1, whose exact supported
value is dimensionless γi = ωi = 1 , and grants MAP permission through the historically owner-approved
SCI-PTC:uniform_coefficient_handoff@draft-0.1. Those exact approvals and literal identiﬁers remain immutable; they
neither activate this r0.3 candidate generation nor realize an object decision. Registration and permission do not
select a family or realize a handoﬀ. MAP shall use this family only after explicit selection; one immutable completed
SCI-PTC v0.1/r0.5 transformed-product publication bound to the exact application, CAL parent, observation, and
selection lineage and typed as a complete segment, complete scan, or bounded chunk wholly within one named scan
or segment and one observation; exact target/payload/occurrence association; and a requested, applicable, eligible,
realized proﬁle evaluation under an exact active compatible binding generation. MAP does not reproduce, select,
or infer the PTC-owned formula. An absent selection without an authorized mode default, unregistered family, in-
Candidate | no conformity or performance claim Page 23

SCI-MAP v0.2 | Formal Scientiﬁc/Engineering Contract Document r0.3
active dependent binding, incomplete PTC publication, missing or mismatched payload, unavailable coeﬃcient/QC
decision, or incompatible generation makes the aﬀected route unavailable; there is no unity or alternate-family fall-
back. Structural availability remains distinct from ﬁniteness. MAP alone classiﬁes an authorized payload as ﬁnite
positive, exact zero, negative ﬁnite, non-ﬁnite, or unrepresentable and applies only a matching ﬁnite strictly-positive
value. The uniform family supplies no precision, sensitivity, loading, scatter, response, covariance, exposure, validity,
optimality, or default meaning.
SCI-MAP-REQ-007 – Exposure lineage and accounting. ALIGN-owned eacq and valid-original evo, in
seconds, shall remain immutable on stable original occurrences through RTC/CAL/PTC. The products are
normatively upstream_eligible_original_footprint_exposure and retained_original_footprint_exposure.
The shorter prose labels “upstream-eligible exposure” and “retained exposure” are explicit aliases for those
products and no others. MAP shall deduplicate by exact observation, detector occurrence/UID, stable orig-
inal/native occurrence, stable ALIGN slot, and ALIGN mapping generation; place each positive- evo origi-
nal exactly once through SCI-AST_TO_SCI-MAP_ORIGINAL_FOOTPRINT_COORDINATE v0.1/r0.1 , its layered AST ALIGN-grid
direction/tangent/continuous-pixel parent in the exact target MAP WCS, and SCI-MAP:one_hot_containing_pixel@1;
and never use a descendant RTC-output coordinate. Geometry/pointing realization, frame, coordinate validity,
boundary state, parent, and version are required. Upstream-eligible and retained exposure diﬀer only by ancestor-
population restriction. Causal inﬂuence, representative RTC occurrence, and original-footprint exposure remain
separate. These exposure products are not complete temporal support, eﬀective map integration time, precision,
or normalized-map inﬂuence. Missing original-coordinate authority makes the aﬀected exposure role unavailable.
Invalid-original has evo = 0; synthesis, replacement, donor reuse, overlapping ﬁlters, and decimation create no expo-
sure. Boundary loss contributes nowhere. Coadd exposure unions atomically admitted observation-scoped original
identities.
SCI-MAP-REQ-008 – Response information state. Every valid SCI-MAP:base_observation_map@1 product shall
disclose its known MAP-local realized operator response AMAP, Π , including exact input/output domains, mem-
bership, projection, coeﬃcient, support-row, WCS, parent, lifecycle, and limitations. MAP shall separately type
upstream-conditioned ﬁxed-state linear response, PTC full-procedure ﬁnite diﬀerences, and PTC+MAP re-resolved
procedure response. An available ﬁxed-state object shall also bind source domain, PTC-sample codomain, units,
parents, response basis, and upstream limitations. Every numerical full-procedure ∆ zPTC-FP, ∆ mPTC-FP, or
∆ mPTC+MAP-RR shall bind the complete SCI-MAP-FULL-PROCEDURE-COMPARISON-SPACE record. A numerical full-procedure
diﬀerence is deﬁned only by the complete immutable SCI-MAP-FULL-PROCEDURE-COMPARISON-SPACE record. The record
binds baseline and perturbed product identities; scientiﬁc quantity and unit; occurrence or MAP output-row identi-
ties; source and target frame/WCS; additive reference, gauge, and null- space state; baseline and perturbed support;
coeﬃcient and response basis; one exact common comparison domain; an exact map from each result into that do-
main; explicit treatment of rows present in only one result; perturbation amplitude, sign, side, location, source state,
and normalization; ﬁnite- diﬀerence convention; state-transition record; and numerical availability with cause. It
authorizes no implicit zero ﬁll, union-domain sentinel, support intersection, coordinate-nearest or same-shape/row-
position association, interpolation, reprojection, or gauge alignment. Without the complete authorized record the
numerical diﬀerence is unavailable, or the result is only a separately typed state transition/discontinuity. ∆ SPTC-FP
never establishes subtractability by itself. The PTC+MAP family reruns PTC and separately resolves Π 0 and Π +,
whose membership and Sout may diﬀer; subtraction is unavailable without exact maps into one authorized common
comparison domain. A coadd-re-resolved/full-procedure response and a whole-chain RTC-to-CAL-to-PTC-to-MAP
response each require separately authorized complete procedures and remain unavailable unless so established. Ab-
sent upstream response shall be reported as limited or unavailable without concealing the known MAP-local operator,
invalidating an otherwise valid base map, fabricating a procedure/whole-chain identity, or prohibiting later analysis.
A later response estimate or corrected map is a new immutable versioned product bound to the original MAP
product and processing identity.
SCI-MAP-REQ-009 – Immutable plan, lifecycle, and attempt outcome. The exact MAP lifecycle is
requested, effective, observation_resolved, applied, realized, in that order. requested is immutable
accepted intent. effective is its supported executable interpretation. observation_resolved means every
observation-speciﬁc parent, coeﬃcient, proﬁle, geometry, mapping, parameter, support rule, output role, and
persistence decision is concrete or typed unavailable. applied binds the exact resolved operation and param-
eter state to the invocation or commitment of one execution attempt. realized exists only when actual im-
mutable accumulators, scientiﬁc output rows, product values, role-qualiﬁed companion statuses, product iden-
tity, and provenance were produced. Attempt outcome is a separate axis with values succeeded, failed, and
not_produced. A stop before application has neither an applied nor a realized product record. An applied at-
Candidate | no conformity or performance claim Page 24

SCI-MAP v0.2 | Formal Scientiﬁc/Engineering Contract Document r0.3
tempt that fails retains its attempt identity and immutable failure-evidence record but creates no realized MAP
product. An applied attempt with no support-authorized output rows has outcome not_produced, not failure,
and likewise creates no realized product. MAP product realization and application-attempt outcome are inde-
pendent. succeeded means the requested immutable MAP product was realized. failed means the attempt
terminated at an exact failure stage and retains cause, aﬀected scope, and nonmutation evidence without a realized
MAP product or completion marker. not_produced means no MAP product was realized without asserting pro-
ducer failure; the authorized empty-support case uses this value. A response or covariance status of unavailable
inside a permitted realized base bundle is a companion-status fact, not attempt failure. Evidence-artifact real-
ization is another independent axis. The same ordered lifecycle shall bind the MAP plan, coeﬃcient selection
and application, projection, support policy, output plan, coadd plan, response and covariance requests, every in-
dependently requested product role, and coverage_cut. The MAP lifecycle does not replace the independently
named PTC/V AL handoﬀ axes requested/not_requested, applicable/inapplicable/applicability_unknown,
eligible/ineligible/decision_unavailable, and realized/incomplete/failed/not_produced. It also does
not replace the ECS requirement-result vocabulary or evidence- artifact realization state. In particular, a MAP
parameter’s resolved or applied value may be checked before application or bound after application; its realized
value is never a prerequisite for a pre-application check. The 2026-09-08 owner directive selects for this r0.3 candi-
date the following empty-support disposition; ﬁnal acceptance of these exact r0.3 bytes remains pending. If a valid
applied support policy yields Sout = ∅, or a valid applied coadd support policy yields S c
out = ∅, the application state
is applied_no_support_authorized_output_rows, the product and attempt outcome is not_produced, and the
exact cause is no_support_authorized_output_rows. The record retains request, eﬀective, observation-resolved,
and applied stages; exact parent and plan; coeﬃcient, projection, support, role and proﬁle identities; Q⋆, thresholds
and support predicates; proof that the output-row set is empty; attempt identity, cause, and provenance. It has
no realized MAP product or completion marker and publishes no dense zero map, zero-sky measurement, valid
ordinary signal plane, no-row coadd member, or fabricated response/covariance plane. No immutable empty-row
scientiﬁc-bundle alternative is authorized. Disabled expert values remain inactive; one observation’s resolved state
shall not leak into another.
SCI-MAP-REQ-010 – Factored contribution predicate. For each pixel, membership in Cp shall be the
conjunction of ten exact Boolean pass predicates derived from separately retained typed records: transformed-
signal availability; PTC output retention; coeﬃcient availability; PTC coeﬃcient/QC proposition passγ, QC; MAP
upstream admission; AST coordinate validity; ﬁnite zi; ﬁnite strictly positive γi; admitted projection/boundary re-
lation; and MAP-local contribution plus required-companion predicates. Every V AL-evaluated gate retains named
request, applicability, eligibility, and realization ﬁelds; only request= requested, applicability=applicable, eligibil-
ity=eligible, and realization= realized passes. Every other ﬁeld combination is nonpassing with its exact cause,
failure scope, and immutable reason retained. A structural source- or proﬁle-binding failure is recorded only when
that structural condition actually occurs; an ordinary nonpassing ﬁeld value is not thereby a structural failure.
Evaluation follows the ordered DAG: A structural identity/parent, generation, source/proﬁle, producer availability,
and decision-realization checks; B retrieval only of structurally admitted payloads and MAP classiﬁcation of zi and
γi; C AST validity, one-hot boundary/placement, and MAP-local required companions; D membership construc-
tion; E accumulation. All gates pass before payload arithmetic. Reading an authorized payload to classify it is not
arithmetic, and excluded non-ﬁnite values never contaminate accumulation. T/F/U/C or four-ﬁeld records shall
never be conjoined directly; no numeric-zero mask represents exclusion.

SCI-MAP-REQ-013 – Accumulator interpretation. The numerator is a pre-normalized accumulator and Qp
is a normalization fact by default. Neither shall be labeled a sky estimator, inverse variance, conﬁdence, coverage,
or signiﬁcance without the separately required conditions.
SCI-MAP-REQ-014 – Constant preservation. With ﬁxed admitted membership and positive coeﬃcients, the
ordinary estimator shall preserve a constant admitted sample input on every row in its exact support-authorized
output set. This prediction shall not create rows outside that set or be promoted to compact-source, extended-source,
integrated-ﬂux, absolute-oﬀset, or astrometric ﬁdelity.
SCI-MAP-REQ-015 – Projection-speciﬁc estimand. The authorized base projection is exactly
SCI-MAP:one_hot_containing_pixel@1; it preserves unity over the ﬁnite in-grid domain and has explicit half-open bound-
ary loss. Fractional projection, diagonal weighted least squares, and conservation across a ﬁnite boundary are
outside this branch until separately authorized.

SCI-MAP-REQ-017 – Realized response claim. A stored kernel may be called a realized ﬁxed-state response
to template τ only when its exact sample parent satisﬁes k = Hﬁxed, Θ τ and the support-restricted map satisﬁes
ˆkout = AMAP, Π Hﬁxed, Θ τ = Rﬁxed, Θ τ on exactly the signal rows. A PTC full-procedure ﬁnite diﬀerence ∆ zPTC-FP
and either map diﬀerence shall retain its distinct family identity and the complete comparison-space record, includ-

domain and exact two maps, unmatched-row treatment, perturbation and ﬁnite-diﬀerence convention, state transi-
tion, availability, and cause. ∆ SPTC-FP records state change but never authorizes numerical subtraction. Otherwise
the response is a tracer, separately typed discontinuity, limited, or unavailable.
SCI-MAP-REQ-018 – Absolute-oﬀset mode. SCI-MAP v0.2 shall apply no signal-centering operation: L = I.
Coaddition shall not subtract a mean, remove a constant mode, or recenter a source; any upstream loss of that
mode shall remain explicit in response and provenance.
SCI-MAP-REQ-019 – Conditional covariance. When a declared PTC-domain covariance NPTC is available
for the exact ﬁxed membership and state Θ , MAP shall propagate it as Cm, out = AMAP, Π NPTCAT
MAP, Π , retaining
consequential oﬀ-diagonal terms on the exact operator domains. The equation is complete only on the declared
available domain. Missing, limited, symbolic, summarized, lineage-resolvable, or unavailable terms remain typed
and are never zero-ﬁlled or interpreted as independence; absence of a complete model does not invalidate the signal
map.

on the asserted domain, and ∑

SCI-MAP-REQ-022 – Covariance and nuisance disclosure. The bundle shall report what uncertainty or
covariance information it actually provides, its meaning, domain, assumptions, and limitations, and whether fuller
Candidate | no conformity or performance claim Page 26

SCI-MAP v0.2 | Formal Scientiﬁc/Engineering Contract Document r0.3
information is persisted, lineage-resolvable, summarized, incomplete, or unavailable. It shall list omitted correlations
and nuisance terms; absence of a complete covariance model shall not invalidate the map or prohibit later analysis,
and unavailable information shall not be set to zero. A later covariance estimate may be attached only as a new
versioned product bound to the original MAP product and processing identity.
SCI-MAP-REQ-023 – Data-derived state. If membership, coeﬃcients, response, or geometry are estimated
or selected from the same data, the displayed linear expectation and covariance shall remain explicitly conditional;
unconditional bias or covariance requires a named joint model or resampling result outside this ﬁxed-state claim.
SCI-MAP-REQ-024 – No signiﬁcance promotion. Signal multiplied by the square root of merely formal
weight shall be labeled formal standardized signal, not sig2noise or empirical signiﬁcance. SCI-NOI owns its
exact realization-generation, empirical-uncertainty, conditional-scale, and standardization methods and products.
Any physical- noise, total-uncertainty, covariance-completeness, signiﬁcance, probability, false-rate, completeness,
purity, or catalogue interpretation requires a separately approved exact method and remains unavailable by de-
fault. MAP therefore keeps Q normalization, formal conditional precision, complete conditional covariance, the
NOI conditional_detector_sign_randomization_marginal_second_moment, the NOI standardized signal, and
any future calibrated-signiﬁcance method as distinct identities and claims. In particular, MAP shall not equate
this quantity with NOI’s conditional marginal second moment or standardized signal, and no future calibrated
signiﬁcance product is inferred.
SCI-MAP-REQ-025 – Distinct map facts. Every base/unﬁltered MAP bundle shall separately represent AST-
geometric incidence, MAP-route-candidate incidence, estimator-admitted contribution, admitted-observation count,
upstream_eligible_original_footprint_exposure, retained_original_footprint_exposure, numerical-
normalization support, science-policy support, and MAP-local base-product scientiﬁc validity. No fact or
downstream eligibility decision shall become authority for another.
SCI-MAP-REQ-026 – Incidence layers. AST-geometric incidence records valid coordinate placement indepen-
dent of signal availability; MAP-route-candidate incidence additionally requires the exact realized PTC route and
occurrence-level upstream admission; estimator contribution additionally requires all remaining gates in Cp. The
one-hot touch convention counts the unique containing pixel only.
SCI-MAP-REQ-027 – Estimator contributions. Estimator-admitted contributions shall count exactly i ∈ C p.
A candidate ineligible under the exact MAP admission or contribution policy for its preserved cause, or with
unavailable/conﬂicting required state, zero/negative/non-ﬁnite coeﬃcient, non-ﬁnite signal, or out-of-grid projection,
contributes nowhere; no producer ﬂag implies a universal action.
SCI-MAP-REQ-028 – Admitted observation count. For coadds, admitted observation count shall count
complete observation bundles contributing at the pixel and shall not be confused with sample hits or observation
attempts.
SCI-MAP-REQ-029 – Upstream-eligible original-footprint exposure. MAP
upstream_eligible_original_footprint_exposure shall union and deduplicate exact positive- evo original
occurrences that are ancestors of route candidates admitted by SCI-MAP:map_upstream_admission@2. Each original is
placed once by its own exact AST coordinate and the one-hot half-open rule; it is not placed at every descendant
coordinate. The exposure population precedes coeﬃcient positivity and MAP-local numerical rejection. Missing
original-coordinate or lineage authority makes this exposure role unavailable.
SCI-MAP-REQ-030 – Retained original-footprint exposure. MAP
retained_original_footprint_exposure shall use the same original-occurrence key and own-coordinate
placement as REQ-029, restricted to originals that are ancestors of estimator-admitted members. Overlapping
ﬁlters, decimation, replacement, synthesis, and multiple descendants do not duplicate seconds. Coadded exposure
shall union observation-scoped original identities after atomic coadd admission; one original can occupy at most
one pixel under the base one-hot family, or none after boundary loss. Neither exposure is precision.

immutable before observation-map construction. Observation maps constructed on that exact grid, or otherwise
compatible observation/coadd shapes, shall use exact centered-integer embedding: shape diﬀerences are nonnegative
and even in each axis, and the corresponding integer oﬀset maps reference pixels to the same world coordinate. A
later crop is a newly identiﬁed row-selected product with immutable parent and lineage; it shall not relabel the
parent or make it retrospectively compatible. Fractional shift, post-hoc pad, reprojection, interpolation, wrapping,
implicit recentering, mosaicking, and a diﬀerent sky grid are outside this estimator.

atan2(∥u × v∥, u·v) between unit direction vectors in that exact declared frame, evaluated with IEEE-754 binary64

the representation fails; the point is not dropped. A center is absent only when its scientiﬁc row was already absent
before population generation; every listed outer-boundary vertex remains required. No smaller sampled subset or
continuum/global-sky claim is authorized. The 0.1-arcsec bound is only the maximum over that exact preregistered
ﬁnite population; it is not a continuum or global-sky maximum. Exact axis sign, handedness, orientation, and
centered-integer shape/reference-pixel relations remain required independently of the numerical bound.

and support predicates; proof that the output-row set is empty; attempt identity, cause, and provenance. It has no
realized MAP product or completion marker and publishes no dense zero map, zero-sky measurement, valid ordinary
signal plane, no-row coadd member, or fabricated response/covariance plane. No immutable empty-row scientiﬁc-
bundle alternative is authorized. and is not an admitted coadd member. Persisted per-observation products are
the normal scientiﬁc expectation and shall be published whenever the eﬀective v0.2 output plan designates them re-
quired; every required publication shall complete or the declared operation fails without a completion claim. A plan
may instead permit a fully in-memory route. A coadd-only entry may consume persisted conforming observation
bundles without rerunning upstream processing. In-memory and persisted routes shall use identical logical admis-
sion, arithmetic, role and base-parent identity, lifecycle, attempt outcome, and provenance. Optional nonpublication
of a realized logical product does not imply that the product did not exist; no-support nonproduction means that
no logical observation product exists. This MAP rule does not waive PTC’s upstream atomic required-publication
obligations.
SCI-MAP-REQ-049 – Immutable base parent. Every stronger observation/coadd role and downstream
transformation shall preserve the exact resolvable base/unﬁltered MAP-bundle or base-coadd identity, ordered
membership, lifecycle, and MAP-local base-product validity. A later local validity/eligibility decision may diﬀer
for its named use but shall not rewrite MAP validity, alter the original claims, sever parentage, or select a hidden
subset of an existing base parent. Later response or covariance estimates are new versioned products.
SCI-MAP-REQ-050 – Complete consumer boundary . No consumer shall receive a bare signal plane as
a scientiﬁcally complete map. The boundary shall include exact product role, request, base parent and mem-
bership; quantity and nominal-beam identity; estimator/normalization/coeﬃcient/proﬁle identity; honest response
class/state and uncertainty/covariance disclosure; distinct map and exposure facts; PTC additive-reference/removed-
component/null-space state; exact frame/WCS, shape/indexing, all reached lifecycle stages, parentage, dependency
versions, comparison-space record when applicable, and failures. Later analyses choose their own exact claim require-
ments and may attach honest versioned response/covariance products; MAP does not own their eligibility. SCI-NOI
owns its exact realization-generation, empirical-uncertainty, conditional-scale, and standardization methods and
products. Any physical- noise, total-uncertainty, covariance-completeness, signiﬁcance, probability, false-rate, com-
pleteness, purity, or catalogue interpretation requires a separately approved exact method and remains unavailable
by default. MAP therefore keeps Q normalization, formal conditional precision, complete conditional covariance,
the NOI conditional_detector_sign_randomization_marginal_second_moment, the NOI standardized signal,
and any future calibrated-signiﬁcance method as distinct identities and claims.
SCI-MAP-REQ-051 – Same ﬁxed noise operator. An admitted noise realization may be described as using
the same map/coadd operator only when eligibility, projection, grouping, coeﬃcients, normalization, exact support-
authorized row selection, boundary, and atomic coadd admission are ﬁxed or identically prescribed. Re-estimation
from the randomized data deﬁnes a diﬀerent named estimator.
SCI-MAP-REQ-052 – Method and claim separation. Pointing and OOF may be registered consumers of
the exact ordinary MAP gridding operator only when their inputs satisfy this operator contract. Reuse grants no
mode-speciﬁc WCS/frame, source model, ﬁtting, response interpretation, output, default, or qualiﬁcation authority;
an unsupplied mode proﬁle remains unavailable. This authority shall not otherwise be applied by analogy to JINC,
maximum-likelihood mapmaking, OOF residual transfer, reprojection, ﬁltering, empirical noise, ﬁtting, Beammap
inference, feedback, Stokes Q/U, measured-R mapmaking, or other units. Independent inspection, modiﬁcation,
experimentation, and proposal remain unrestricted, while an altered scientiﬁc identity or oﬃcial claim requires an
explicit versioned successor and evidence appropriate to that claim. Algebraic contract correctness, engineering
conformance, representation/response ﬁdelity, observational performance, and production readiness shall remain
separate claims.

D Falsiﬁable predictions
These predictions are preregistered contract consequences or conformance challenges. Their presence is not validation
evidence.
SCI-MAP-PRED-001 – Uniform constant. For ﬁxed membership, a constant admitted input with uniform
positive coeﬃcients produces that constant on every support-authorized MAP-valid output row; numerator and
normalization scale together, and no unsupported scientiﬁc row is created. Primary claim layer: Algebraic contract.
SCI-MAP-PRED-002 – Unequally weighted constant. For ﬁxed membership, unequal positive coeﬃcients
still preserve the same constant on every support-authorized output row, while normalization and conditional
variance generally change with position; rows outside that set have no normalized scientiﬁc value. Primary claim
layer: Algebraic contract.
SCI-MAP-PRED-003 – One-pixel hand calculation. For an authorized row with admitted zi and ai > 0, the
exact triplet is (N, Q, ˆm) = ( ∑aizi, ∑ai, ∑aizi/ ∑ai); an unauthorized row has no normalized scientiﬁc value.
Primary claim layer: Algebraic contract.
SCI-MAP-PRED-004 – One-hot boundary . A ﬁnite coordinate inside exactly one half-open cell has one
Gpi = 1 , preserves unity over pixels, and contributes only there. A coordinate on an internal upper edge belongs
to the adjacent cell; a coordinate on the outer upper extent or outside the grid contributes nowhere. Fractional
splitting is not authorized. Primary claim layer: Algebraic contract.
SCI-MAP-PRED-005 – Delta input. For a declared ﬁxed state, a basis-pixel sky perturbation produces the
corresponding support-row-restricted column of Rﬁxed, Θ = AMAP, Π Hﬁxed, Θ , including projection and boundary
truncation. A PTC full-procedure or PTC+MAP re-resolved numerical diﬀerence exists only when its complete
authorized comparison-space record supplies exact common domains and both row maps; absent that record it is
unavailable or only a typed state transition/discontinuity and need not equal the ﬁxed-state column. Primary claim
layer: Representation ﬁdelity.
SCI-MAP-PRED-006 – Point-source template. A declared point-source perturbation τb produces Rﬁxed, Θ τb
only for the exact ﬁxed response state and authorized rows. PTC full-procedure and PTC+MAP re-resolved
families additionally retain baseline/perturbed identities, perturbation side/sign/amplitude/location/source
state/normalization, ﬁnite-diﬀerence convention, gauge/support/bases, exact common domain and row maps,
state transition, availability, and cause. The unavailable whole-chain RTC-to-CAL-to-PTC-to-MAP family is not
inferred. Peak, integrated, and ﬁtted amplitudes remain distinct functionals. Primary claim layer: Representation
ﬁdelity.
SCI-MAP-PRED-007 – Resolved and F ourier inputs. At ﬁxed state, resolved disks, gradients, and Fourier
modes produce their explicit Rﬁxed, Θ τ on the authorized row set; a constant-input pass does not predict preservation
of these modes, and procedure-response families are not inferred from the ﬁxed matrix. Primary claim layer:
Representation ﬁdelity.
SCI-MAP-PRED-008 – Variable coverage. Fixed-coeﬃcient constant preservation can coexist with spatially
varying normalization, support-row membership, covariance, and nonconstant-template response; a row that fails
support is absent rather than measured zero. Primary claim layer: Algebraic contract.
SCI-MAP-PRED-009 – Finite boundary . At an admitted ﬁnite edge, no contribution wraps or clamps; local
normalization may preserve a constant while compact-source peak or integrated response changes. Primary claim
layer: Representation ﬁdelity.
SCI-MAP-PRED-010 – Coeﬃcient states. The admitted uniform family yields exact dimensionless γi = 1
only for an explicit selection with complete PTC publication, exact target/payload/occurrence association, MAP
permission, and a requested, applicable, eligible, realized named handoﬀ under the exact compatible source binding.
Registry presence alone realizes nothing. Missing selection or handoﬀ remains unavailable with no fallback. Struc-
tural availability is independent of numerical class; MAP alone classiﬁes ﬁnite positive, exact zero, negative ﬁnite,
non-ﬁnite, and unrepresentable. Zero is noncontributing and the other nonpositive/non-ﬁnite classes are invalid
with exact cause; uniform one is not precision. Primary claim layer: Engineering conformance.
SCI-MAP-PRED-011 – Use-qualiﬁed exclusion and non-ﬁnite states. A candidate whose typed gate record
projects to Boolean nonmembership does not contaminate an accumulator. Structural exclusion prevents payload

retrieval; structurally admitted payloads are read only for safe MAP numerical classiﬁcation before membership
and arithmetic. Its complete named-ﬁeld or other typed record, immutable reason, and cause remain preserved; no
universal producer-ﬂag action is inferred. Primary claim layer: Engineering conformance.
SCI-MAP-PRED-012 – Threshold selector. For each predeclared positive ﬁnite coeﬃcient population, the
selected zero-based index is exactly ⌊(⌊0. 75N ⌋+ N )/ 2⌋; empty input uses the exact boundary convention Q⋆ = 0
while selecting no population element and asserting no zero-sky measurement. No row gains support without
its own ﬁnite positive Qp. Small N ﬁxtures straddle every integer-index transition. At exact c = 0 , both rel-
ative thresholds are zero and the ﬁnite-positive requirement still excludes zero, negative, non-ﬁnite, or absent
normalization. Values 0 < c ≤ 1 use inclusive comparisons in the ordinary recommended range. A c > 1 value
is admitted only with the independently true, same-value/scope coverage_cut_above_one_override_requested
fact and may yield empty support; the number does not authorize itself. That prospective applied case has state
applied_no_support_authorized_output_rows, outcome not_produced, exact like-named cause, no failure, and
no realized MAP product. Negative, non-ﬁnite, missing, or unrepresentable c fails before application or required-
product mutation. Every reached cut stage is retained, with all ﬁve only for successful product realization; pre-
application validation checks the observation-resolved value and never requires a realized value. Primary claim
layer: Algebraic contract.
SCI-MAP-PRED-013 – Missing response. Every SCI-MAP:base_observation_map@1 discloses its known MAP-local
realized operator response on exact signal rows. Missing upstream response yields a separately typed limited or
unavailable state on complete signal membership, never a smaller subset, zero, or identity. SCI-MAP:response_bearing_
observation_map@1 is unavailable for that exact base parent only when its exact selected role request names that exact
response-family object as required; absence of a diﬀerent ﬁxed-state, full-procedure, re-resolved, coadd-procedure,
or whole-chain family does not block an otherwise complete named response role. Each numerical full-procedure
diﬀerence requires its complete SCI-MAP-FULL-PROCEDURE-COMPARISON-SPACE record. Coadd-full-procedure/re-resolved and
whole-chain responses remain separately unavailable unless authorized. The base bundle remains usable for claims
that do not require the absent response; any later response estimate or corrected map has a new versioned identity
bound to the original. Primary claim layer: Engineering conformance.
SCI-MAP-PRED-014 – Role-qualiﬁed atomic rejection. After exact activation makes the proposed aggre-
gate proﬁle evaluable, a required companion incompatibility rejects the complete observation before coadd mutation
at the selected role scope. Under SCI-MAP:base_coadd@1, unavailable or basis-incompatible response does not change
signal membership; it yields unavailable coadd response with exact cause and no hidden subset or zero compan-
ion. Under SCI-MAP:response_bearing_coadd@1, a mixed or incompatible response-family identity, missing ﬁxed-state
condition, or absent exact composition theorem blocks that role for an existing base parent. A required covariance
incompatibility analogously blocks SCI-MAP:covariance_qualified_coadd@1. Any separately requested admission may
reject the observation only before constructing its own explicitly identiﬁed base/signal parent. Other required iden-
tity, unit, WCS, shape, policy, and parent incompatibilities remain atomic at their declared role scope. The current
candidate has no active proﬁle or realized object decision. Primary claim layer: Engineering conformance.
SCI-MAP-PRED-015 – One-observation coadd. After exact proﬁle activation and a realized eligible object
decision, a SCI-MAP:base_coadd@1 containing one admitted base observation under the uniform dimensionless coef-
ﬁcient family reproduces its signal on corresponding centered-integer authorized rows. If the valid applied coadd
support policy authorizes no rows, outcome is instead not_produced with exact no-support cause and no zero coadd.
Conforming in-memory and persisted bundles give the same admission, identity, and arithmetic. Unavailable or
basis-incompatible upstream response leaves nonempty signal membership unchanged and makes coadd response un-
available with exact cause. SCI-MAP:response_bearing_coadd@1 reproduces response only when it binds one exact family

SCI-MAP-PRED-016 – Uniform observation coeﬃcients. On each authorized coadd row, two com-
patible observations produce their equal-observation arithmetic mean and count-like normalization under
SCI-MAP:uniform_observation_coadd_coefficient@1. Each requested coadd role binds its own exact parent, lifecycle,

exact base parent. A response-bearing coadd additionally binds one exact compatible response family and the ﬁxed
coadd state/composition authority; a ﬁnite diﬀerence without an exact composition theorem is not propagated as
a Jacobian. Coadd-full-procedure/re-resolved and whole-chain response remain unavailable. The normalization is
not precision. Primary claim layer: Algebraic contract.

SCI-MAP-PRED-017 – Missing, invalid, or no-support observation. An unsupported observation row
contributes at no coadd row; an observation rejected by the exact selected role contributes nowhere to that separately
identiﬁed base/signal parent and does not increment its count. An applied observation attempt with no support-
authorized output rows has outcome not_produced, is not an admitted coadd member, and has no signal, response,
covariance, exposure, count, validity, or completion product. A companion unavailable but permitted by a realized
base role does not remove the observation and is not attempt failure. No case creates a zero-valued scientiﬁc or
companion substitute. Primary claim layer: Engineering conformance.
SCI-MAP-PRED-018 – Centered integer placement. A canonical target grid requested before construction
yields observation maps already bound to that grid. Other compatible shape diﬀerences that are nonnegative and
even produce the exact half-diﬀerence row/column oﬀset; odd, negative, fractional, or WCS-inconsistent relations
fail with no mutation. The FITS representation comparison evaluates every preregistered addressable pixel center
and outer-boundary cell vertex, including all corners, with the exact spherical metric and invalid-point rule. A later
crop is a new row-selected product with its own identity and lineage and cannot relabel its parent as compatible.
Primary claim layer: Engineering conformance.
SCI-MAP-PRED-019 – Cross-observation covariance. For two maps with variances σ2
1, σ 2
2 and covariance c,
a complete SCI-MAP:covariance_qualified_coadd@1 over the exact base-coadd membership includes c through Σ obs. If
a required block is missing, that stronger role is unavailable for the parent; the base role retains a partial, symbolic,
summarized, lineage-resolvable, or unavailable state. No subset is formed, the block is never zero or independence,
and equal-observation normalization is not precision. Primary claim layer: Algebraic contract.
SCI-MAP-PRED-020 – Fixed noise operator. A deterministic admitted realization propagated with ﬁxed
state yields the same support-row identities and coeﬃcient-by-coeﬃcient AMAP, Π ≡ Aout and Bout as the signal
path; recomputed state exposes a named diﬀerence. Primary claim layer: Engineering conformance.
SCI-MAP-PRED-021 – Sequential and parallel reduction. Integer facts, identities, masks, support, and
cardinality agree exactly. Floating sums agree with a preregistered operation-count/conditioning bound that is
frozen before results are viewed and is not loosened after failure. Primary claim layer: Engineering conformance.
SCI-MAP-PRED-022 – No false signiﬁcance. A deliberate attempt to label signal times square root of
merely formal weight as empirical signiﬁcance is rejected or remains unmistakably labeled formal standardized
signal. Primary claim layer: Engineering conformance.
SCI-MAP-PRED-023 – No validity promotion. A downstream product may have its own use-local validity
or eligibility but cannot change MAP-local base-product validity or sever the base/unﬁltered MAP parent. Primary
claim layer: Engineering conformance.
SCI-MAP-PRED-024 – No ordinary predicate for JINC. A deliberate attempt to apply positive-coeﬃcient
ordinary admission, support, or complete-bundle availability to JINC is rejected as outside SCI-MAP v0.2. Primary
claim layer: Engineering conformance.
SCI-MAP-PRED-025 – Aggregate, index, and no-support outcomes. An exact-zero, non-ﬁnite, overﬂowed,
or unrepresentable aggregate/index never becomes a live valid product; failure occurs at the declared scope before
mutation or completion. Separately, a valid applied policy whose support-authorized output-row set is empty
produces no product with exact not_produced outcome and cause no_support_authorized_output_rows; it is
not a failure and creates no dense zero substitute. Primary claim layer: Engineering conformance.

The six independently requestable product roles are SCI-MAP:base_observation_map@1, SCI-MAP:response_bearing_

coadd@1, and SCI-MAP:covariance_qualified_coadd@1. Every request has its own immutable identity, parent set, ordered
MAP lifecycle, result, and failure scope. A stronger role is a new product over the exact base parent; it does not
rewrite that parent’s signal membership, response/covariance status, validity, or provenance.
